agrivision.name: AgriVision
agrivision.description: Hlaziya izithombe zezitshalo ukuze uhlonze izifo, izinambuzane, nokushoda kwezakhamzimba. Thola ukuhlola okusheshayo nezincomo zokwelapha namathiphu okuvimbela.

isdaSoil.name: ISDA Soil
isdaSoil.description: Thola imininingwane enemininingwane ngenhlabathi efaka i-pH, i-nitrogen, i-phosphorus, i-potassium, nezinye izakhamzimba. Ukuhlanganisa kufaka yonke i-Afrika ngokucacisa okungamamitha angama-30.

accuweather.name: AccuWeather
accuweather.tagline: Isimo samanje sezulu nezibikezelo zesimo sezulu emhlabeni wonke
accuweather.description: Finyelela idatha yesimo sezulu yesikhathi sangempela efaka izinga lokushisa, umswakama, isivinini somoya, nemvula. Izibikezelo zitholakala kuze kube yizinsuku eziyi-15.

gapWeather.name: GAP Weather
gapWeather.description: Izibikezelo zesimo sezulu ezikhethekile zokulima eKenya. Kufaka ukuhwamuka kwamanzi ezitshalweni, ukushisa kwelanga, nezibikezelo zemvula ezenzelwe izinqumo zokulima.

edacap.name: EDACaP Climate
edacap.description: Ukubuka kwesimo sezulu sonyaka kufaka phakathi izibikezelo zokushisa nemvula. Kusiza abalimi ukuhlela izikhathi zokutshala nokuvuna.

weatherapi.name: WeatherAPI
weatherapi.tagline: Idatha yesimo sezulu ezindaweni zomhlaba wonke
weatherapi.description: Insiza ephelele yedatha yesimo sezulu ehlinzeka ngesimo samanje nezibikezelo zezindawo emhlabeni wonke.

tomorrowIo.name: Tomorrow.io
tomorrowIo.description: Ipulatifomu yobuhlakani besimo sezulu esezingeni eliphezulu enezibikezelo ezinokucaca okuphezulu namakhono okubikezela okusheshayo.

feedFormulation.name: Ukuxuba Ukudla Kwemfuyo
feedFormulation.description: Bala ukuxuba kokudla okonga kakhulu kwezinkomo zakho zobisi. Kubheka izinhloso zokukhiqiza ubisi, isisindo somzimba, nokudla okutholakala endaweni.

nextgen.name: NextGen Fertilizer
nextgen.description: Thola izincomo zomanyolo ezinembayo ngokusekelwe endaweni yakho eqondile. Kufaka phakathi izincomo zomanyolo wemvelo (umbolo, umanyolo wezibungu) nongewona owemvelo (i-Urea, i-NPS).

decisionTree.name: Isihlahla Sezinqumo Zesitshalo
decisionTree.description: Thola izincomo zokuphathwa kwezitshalo ngokusekelwe esigabeni sokukhula nasesimweni sezulu samanje. Kukusiza ukuthi wenze izinqumo ezifanele zokulawula izinambuzane, ukuchelela, nokuvuna.

gapAgriculture.name: GAP Agriculture
gapAgriculture.description: Izinsiza ezijwayelekile zokwelulekwa ngezolimo zokuphatha izitshalo nemfuyo.
